## What's new

### Account access and call routing

FS PBX 2.2.6 fixes authorization issues that could let a signed-in user read, change, or delete another account's configuration.

**Highlights**

- Switching accounts now checks the user's current access. Revoking access takes effect even if the account still appears in an open menu.
- Device and phone-number actions require both access to the account and permission for the action. Bulk changes reject the whole selection if it includes a record outside the user's access.
- Business Hours, holidays, and Virtual Receptionist menus now enforce account ownership when viewing or changing records. Applying a greeting requires permission to edit that menu, and menu keys can route only to destinations available to the menu's account.
- Location lists, edits, and deletions now respect the active account and the user's location permissions.

[Santosh Kumar Puppala](https://github.com/Santoshkumarpuppala) reported the cross-account issues in holiday records, bulk device updates, and bulk deletion of devices, phone numbers, IVR menus, locations, provisioning templates, and hotel rooms.

### Hotel room and guest access

**Account Settings → Room Management** and **Room Status** now have separate permissions for the work front-desk staff and hotel administrators perform.

**Highlights**

- Grant staff access to view rooms and guest status, check guests in or out, or create, edit, and delete rooms.
- Manage housekeeping codes and the property's PMS provider with separate permissions.
- Room lists, guest names, stay dates, and check-in and checkout actions are limited to the active account. CharPMS and TigerTMS can continue to send check-in and checkout updates independently of staff portal permissions.

The new hotel permissions are granted to superadmins by default. Assign the permissions your hotel staff need to their groups after updating.

### Device provisioning and previews

Open **Provisioning Preview** on a device to inspect its generated configuration and refresh it after changing settings.

**Highlights**

- Use **Refresh** next to **Copy** to reload the preview without closing it.
- Previews mask recognized credential values, including SIP passwords, PINs, and credentials embedded in provisioning URLs. Values typed directly into a template are displayed as written.
- When a device moves accounts, FS PBX clears incompatible profile, key template, provisioning template, and phonebook assignments and tells the administrator what was removed.
- The v1 Device API and native handset provisioning use profiles and provisioning templates available to the device's account, including shared ones. Shipped templates are read-only. Managing shared custom templates requires a permission granted only to superadmins by default.

### Grandstream HT841 and HT881 analog gateways

Select the **HT8x1** device template to connect analog telephone lines to FS PBX. The HT841 supports four outside lines and the HT881 supports eight. Both models also have a port for an analog phone or fax machine.

**Highlights**

- Assign a separate extension and incoming-call destination to each outside line, such as a ring group or IVR.
- Use the default two-stage dialing, or configure a Bridge and outbound route so users can dial an outside number in one step.
- Follow the new setup guide for port assignments, remote gateways behind NAT, and checking inbound and outbound calls. [Grandstream HT841 / HT881 FXO calling](https://www.fspbx.com/docs/phone-provisioning/grandstream-ht8x1-fxo/)

### Conference session history

Open **Sessions** from a conference room to review its history in the native FS PBX interface.

**Highlights**

- View session start and end times, duration, and conference profile, then open a session to inspect its participants.
- Search participants and open their call details when permitted.
- Play or download available conference recordings with the appropriate permissions.
- Delete selected sessions and their participant history while keeping recording files.

Session history, participant details, and recordings are limited to the active account. Existing conference permissions continue to control access.

## Improvements and fixes

- LDAP directories can use independent full **User DN** and **Group DN** paths by leaving **Base DN** blank. **Test Connection** now checks both search locations without requiring a readable common parent, fixing compatibility with directories such as Cloudron. Existing configurations with a Base DN keep their current behavior. [Issue #719](https://github.com/nemerald-voip/fspbx/issues/719)
- Added a complete [Microsoft Active Directory and LDAP setup guide](https://www.fspbx.com/docs/configuration/users-and-groups/active-directory-and-ldap/), including secure connections, group-to-role mappings, sign-in, and a public LDAP test example.
- SIP Status links now open the selected SIP profile or gateway in its native editor.
- Removed unavailable Wallboard and Import buttons from Basic Queues and conference CDR links from Conferences and Conference Rooms. The Schedules dashboard link remains available for older installations that still use it. [PR #692](https://github.com/nemerald-voip/fspbx/pull/692)
- Saved keywords now appear when you reopen an SMS auto-reply rule in **Message Settings → Auto-replies**. [PR #727](https://github.com/nemerald-voip/fspbx/pull/727)
- Fax log searches and selections now require permission to view fax logs. Removed obsolete fax deletion actions.
- Viewing, changing, testing, or deactivating a payment gateway now requires the Payment Gateways permission.
- Retell tool synchronization preserves custom tool settings when updating a conversation flow and displays the provider's error message if an update fails.
- When local web interface changes prevent an update, FS PBX now shows the commands to keep those changes or set them aside and retry.
